% 2.2 The shot of the white rhino was published by Earth Aware or published by Animal Science.
:- shoot("white rhino", _, Mag), Mag != "Earth Aware", Mag != "Animal Science".

% 2.3 The photo published by Animal Science was published by Earth Aware or published by Animal Science.
% This is redundant since the magazine is "Animal Science", so it's always true.
% But we ensure consistency: if a shoot has magazine "Animal Science", it's valid — already enforced.

% 3. The photo of the polar bear was taken sometime before the shot of the white rhino.
:- shoot("polar bear", M1, _), shoot("white rhino", M2, _), M1 >= M2.

% 4. The photo taken in April was published by Animal Science.
:- shoot(_, M, Mag), M = 4, Mag != "Animal Science".

% 5. The photo of the giant tortoise was taken in June.
:- shoot("giant tortoise", M, _), M != 6.
